description: Read one feedback report in full with its append-only lifecycle event history (submit, every status change with notes, subject linkage). When hasConcern is false the report is a Recorded row: present it as 'Recorded', never as an open MINOR concern (those stored values are compatibility shadows). Missing, foreign, and unauthorized ids all read as the same opaque 404. Requires job_feedback:read.
name: opentrain_job_feedback_get
